digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center harness test
propositions: The test asserts substring presence of raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) in ticket JSON, but the created ticket id is lowercased (jira-rbjnazv-1) and the raw key does not appear in the payload, making the assertion impossible to pass
The Jira key binding is stored separately in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return, so the mapping between local and remote ids cannot be verified via json.dumps scan alone
Three sequential oracle defects masked the real issue: empty store state, PAT-cap bug preventing test execution, and incorrect assertion logic
The test must assert exact id match via _jira_key_to_local_id derivation and validate the binding store mapping to prove the DC-created issue appears in local store
The inbound half of the epic acceptance criterion is proven only after this oracle is fixed and the live DC harness job passes
The outbound half (local edit appearing on DC issue) remains unproven as no existing test mutates a local ticket and asserts the change surfaces on DC
